type: independent full-set round-trip verification (no new origin retrieval)
context: Continuation prompt stated a stale baseline of 35 published / 25 remaining. The work branch already carried iterations 3-7..3-9 which drove published 42 -> 60. This iteration independently re-verified the 60/60 claim instead of re-downloading anything.
method: For each of the 60 per-file tags: oras resolve (immutable digest), oras pull of the tag, sha256 of the pulled bytes vs the recorded sha256, and tag digest vs the recorded immutable digest. Genuine cold round-trip, not a smoke artifact.

endToEndOriginCheck.result: origin bytes == published bytes for this file; proves the published sha256 is the true origin file hash

originSpotCheck.note: 1-byte ranged GET against the recorded (correctly encoded) URLs, confirming validators still match state; no bulk re-download.
